title: Enriched semilattice
brief: cells under rest, signatures as meets, phase as enrichment
about: Stated as a conjecture: the cells under the order of rest, with signatures as meets and phase as what each origin carries, look like an enriched meet-semilattice, and what the library proves would be its representation theory.
What can be checked is checked here: identity, composition, associativity, commuting and naturality hold for the operations as vectors.

Observation is not one of them. It moves the metric — a cell two steps away becomes one — and it can split a cell that no signature could, which is why it is a functor out of the category and not an arrow inside it.
